text:
Ivy: Quick UX ask: dashboards that compare different services need a 'normalize' mode so y-values are relative to each series' baseline. Mock: toggle in toolbar 'Normalize across series'. Screenshot: <link>
Marco: +1. Important to surface the unit still. If normalized, legend should show 'requests (normalized)' and axis label becomes '% of baseline'.
Rae: Accessibility: announce transform changes via aria-live: 'Chart view changed to normalized scale'. Also expose an explanation tooltip: 'Normalization rescales series so 100 = series baseline'.
Sven: Outliers: when normalizing, we still need to indicate raw extremes. Proposal: show a faint raw max marker (dotted) and a chevron if raw exceeds plotted range. Clicking chevron toggles 'show raw'.
Ivy: Copy tweak: in legend, append small muted unit token: 'latency · ms' or 'throughput · rps'. If normalized show '· normalized' after unit.
Marco: Smoothing should stay OFF for normalized by default. Add a small preview pill if user toggles smoothing: 'smoothing: 5m (preview)'.
Rae: Keyboard: normalization toggle must be reachable and announceable. Provide aria-pressed state. Also ensure high-contrast stroke for normalized vs raw overlays.
Sven: Perf note: compute normalization factors server-side. Client gets per-series baseline and p50/p95. Avoid normalizing thousands of points in the DOM.
Ivy: UX microcopy for tooltip when hovering a normalized point: 'value: 120% of baseline (raw: 240 reqs)'. Keep it compact.
Marco: Outlier handling options: fade | clamp | raw-toggle. Default for normalized = fade. Log-scale not allowed in normalize mode (confusing).
Rae: For small multiples, default to uniform Y when comparing related metrics; default to independent Y for mix-and-match dashboards. Add a tooltip explaining choice.
Sven: Telemetry: chart.normalize_toggle, chart.raw_expand_click, chart.outlier_mode_change.
ChartBot: Release note: default behaviors: normalize = off, outlier_mode = fade, smoothing = off. Ensure aria-live messages and unit tokens included in legend.
Ivy: I'll prototype a quick Storybook with the normalize toggle + raw marker and send PR. Pairing 2pm tomorrow?
Marco: I'll join. Rae: can you do a11y review?
Rae: Yup, will run through keyboard flow and screen reader labels.
Sven: I'll mock the backend baseline payload. Thanks all.
